kevin_sales: Quick sync: Prospect Evergreen wants a least-privilege POC. Requirements: ephemeral keys, SSO-only onboarding preferred, limit to embeddings+chat, and clarity on Dedicated billing.

anya_se: Proposed POC plan:
- Workspace: evergreen-poc
- Invite: SSO-first, fallback invite links expire in 8h
- Tokens: ephemeral, scoped to role + capabilities (generate:chat,generate:embeddings)
- Dedicated: optional small pool; billing starts on activation; can offer 30d credit for trial.

leo_security: Security checklist: no long-lived admin keys, token TTL <= 8h, issuance/revocation exported to SIEM, no plaintext tokens via email. If customer insists on CMK for hosted, need contract addendum; Private supports customer KMS.

marta_eng: Dev notes: API + UI support invites. Example API body:
{ "email": "contractor@vendor.com", "role": "poc_reader", "expires_in": "8h", "capabilities": ["generate:chat","generate:embeddings"] }
We log mint/revoke events and surface them in Console; audit export supported.

kevin_sales: Can we restrict model upload/fine-tune actions for all POC roles?

anya_se: Yes. Role bits exclude manage:models by default for poc_reader/poc_engineer. Only poc_owner gets manage:* and limit to 1-2 people.

billing_bot: billing-helper: Dedicated trial credit policy drafted: "30-day credit covers activation; standard reserved billing applies after trial or on explicit activation without credit." (ticket #BILL-142)

leo_security: Add to SQA: "POC tokens TTL <=8h; mint/revoke events exported; hosted uses vendor-managed envelope keys unless CMK addendum executed; SSO group mapping enforced for role assignment."

kevin_sales: Actions:
- anya: confirm Dedicated credit wording with finance and paste final line here
- marta: attach invite UI screenshot + API example to the deal folder
- leo: provide one-line SQA acceptance for legal

anya_se: Will confirm with finance by EOD.

kevin_sales: Thanks all, sending this to the buyer now. :thumbsup:
